a db_connection_uri-class secret is exposed in a response — if valid, it grants the privilege it carries (values are masked and never verified destructively)

POST /safe/nosql-login changes state and carries no anti-CSRF token — a hostile origin may be able to forge this action against an authenticated victim
POST /vuln/jwt-login changes state and carries no anti-CSRF token — a hostile origin may be able to forge this action against an authenticated victim
POST /vuln/nosql-login changes state and carries no anti-CSRF token — a hostile origin may be able to forge this action against an authenticated victim
